definitions.explanation: Helping someone accomplish something, especially in a supporting role. As a suru-verb, アシストする means to assist or back up. Often used of technology or equipment that aids the user.
In team sports such as soccer or basketball, a pass or play that directly leads to a teammate scoring.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先輩|せんぱい}→先輩：01451_senpai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧アシスト⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦モーター→モーター：23127_mootaa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{走|はし}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧アシスト⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{新人|しんじん}→新人：02500_shinjin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦うまく→うまい：01279_umai⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{進|すす}められる→進める：01949_susumeru⟧よう、⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧アシスト⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The team helped the newcomer so he could get his work done smoothly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{見事|みごと}→見事：03744_migoto⟧なアシストだった。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{今季|こんき}アシスト⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: He has a lot of assists this season.

examples.japanese: ⟦{絶妙|ぜつみょう}→絶妙：13812_zetsumyou⟧な⟦パス→パス：00340_pasu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧アシストとなり、⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{逆転|ぎゃくてん}→逆転：06839_gyakuten⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: An exquisite pass became the assist, and the team came from behind to win.

notes:
Loanword from English "assist," used both as a general term for support and as a sports statistic. As a suru-verb (アシスト⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧) it means to help or back up.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {電動|でんどう}アシスト{自転車|じてんしゃ}: power-assisted bicycle
- アシスト⟦{機能|きのう}→機能：13165_kinou⟧: assist function (of a device)
- アシスト⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧: to record an assist (in sports)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{支援|しえん}→支援：07778_shien⟧: support, aid — the native term; more formal and often organizational
- ⟦サポート→サポート：07776_sapooto⟧: support — broad loanword; overlaps with sense 1 but not the sports sense
